<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ClaimHandling" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/claim-handling">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ClaimHandling">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" name="Claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ClaimRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAndMark</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_HandlingProceeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Examine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Examine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Examine_Write</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Examine_Write</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_Write</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Write_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAndMark" name="Check recommendation and mark claim OK or Not OK">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Write_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_Status</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimStatus" name="Claim marked OK?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_Status</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Status_OK</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Status_NotOK</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnClaim" name="Send claim back to claims officer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Status_NotOK</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_Write</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_HandlingProceeds" name="Claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Status_OK</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Examine" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Examine_Write" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Write_Check" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckAndMark"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Status" sourceRef="Task_CheckAndMark" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Status_OK" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_HandlingProceeds">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Status_NotOK" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus" targetRef="Task_ReturnClaim">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'Not OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Write" sourceRef="Task_ReturnClaim" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
